<thought>To determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the `carbon_nmr_spectra` tool. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (≈10–30 ppm). By counting distinct carbon signals within this range, I can infer the number of methyl groups present.</thought>
